decisions.what: Kept existing arvad_task_files/ exclusion in .gitignore and appended OS/editor/build-artifact rules
decisions.why: .gitignore already existed with one line; the spec required OS/editor/build entries so appended rather than replaced to preserve prior intent

decisions.what: Rewrote README.md to align with the CounterAct Consult brand tagline, palette, typography, structure, and GitHub Pages deployment guidance
decisions.why: Existing README stub only had the auto-generated project name; the spec required a full brand-aligned overview with all colors, fonts, structure, and deployment notes

decisions.what: Built logos and icons as pure hand-authored SVG using rect primitives on a pixel grid
decisions.why: Brand direction calls for a pixel-aesthetic pattern language on a 40x40 grid; rect-based SVGs deliver that faithfully, stay small, and remain crisp at any scale

decisions.what: Generated favicon.png as a valid 60x60 RGBA PNG (byte-level PNG chunks written from Python) mirroring the icon.svg shield mark
decisions.why: The favicon must be a real PNG (browsers cannot parse SVG under a .png extension) and derived from the icon logo per spec

decisions.what: Used Primary Blue #2C3EF8 for security/lock/firewall, Bright Green #00FD00 for caution, and Light Blue #ABB2FC for info
decisions.why: Each icon spec called out the brand color to apply; the choices satisfy the spec's color guidance and preserve visual hierarchy
